commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: Water within reach of someone seated. Extra cloth behind it, where it stays dry.

commands.speaker: or_volunteer
commands.text: And nobody waits inside the opening, even when the bench is full.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: What do you do when it is full?

commands.speaker: or_volunteer
commands.text: Ask the next group to stop on the firm ground here. I do not press them against the exit.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: Good. That is a place, not a crowd.
Marek puts the empty basket down where its owner can find it again.
